remote.clearQueueConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear all videos from the queue?

remote.lockRoomDesc: Prevent non-admin members from adding tracks to the queue.

remote.ytKeyNeededTitle: MediaBox YouTube API Needed for Keyword Search
remote.ytKeyNeededDesc: Configure the MediaBox YouTube API proxy in TV Room Settings to enable keyword search. You can also paste any direct YouTube link under the Paste Link tab with zero setup!
remote.kickMemberConfirm: Are you sure you want to kick this member and purge their video requests?
remote.radioQueueDesc: Autoplay will continue with this algorithmic queue
remote.noTvConnectedDesc: This room's TV has not configured the MediaBox YouTube API yet. You can paste any direct YouTube link above to queue videos directly.

tvSettings.title: TV Room Settings
tvSettings.description: Configure MediaBox YouTube API, rate limits, and room playback behavior.
tvSettings.rateLimitDesc: Prevent rate abuse by restricting searches per member.
tvSettings.noRateLimits: No active search limits recorded for current members.
tvSettings.countdownDesc: Shows a sci-fi countdown overlay on the TV before playing the next queued video.
tvSettings.preferMusicVideosDesc: When ON, search and autoplay target YouTube Music tracks and music videos. When OFF, standard YouTube video search is used.
tvSettings.lyricsWordSyncDesc: Disables karaoke animations. Recommended on low end hardware.
tvSettings.lyricsOffsetDesc: Fine-tune syllable highlight sync if lyrics appear slightly early or late relative to vocals.
tvSettings.apiTokenDesc: Authorizes this device to search YouTube and resolve lyrics freely without Cloudflare Turnstile human verification challenges.
tvSettings.apiTokenSavedNotice: API token saved to this device.
tvSettings.apiTokenBeamedNotice: API token beamed to TV screen!
